sample_unit: conversations (stratified random sample of HealthBench; 332 mental health conversations identified)

links.outcome: Difference between mental health domain and overall HealthBench benchmark scores
links.effect: Mental health point estimates differed from overall estimates by -0.034 to +0.047 across deployments; domain composition uneven (postpartum depression 26.8%, suicidal crisis 4.5%, psychosis 0.9%, eating disorders 1.5%).
links.quote: Across deployments, mental health point estimates differed from overall estimates by -0.034 to +0.047.

screen.reason: Evaluates benchmark dataset composition and LLM performance reporting across mental health domains versus aggregate scores, but does not test a specific organizational deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
